==Description==
The '''Protein Shake''' is a common consumable exclusively uses in [[PVP]] mode.

It can be used an unlimited number of times, but it costs {{Money|1,000}} to use each time. It has a 45 second cooldown.

==Usage==
Upon use, the '''Protein Shake''' would add the [[Bloated]] attribute to three enemies sent by the team the player is in. These attributes would be put in a queue, meaning all the previously sent attributes need to be applied first. It only applies it to three enemies, not three groups of enemies. For example, if nine [[Normal]]s were sent in a single group, only three of them would be [[Bloated]].

==Appearance==
The '''Protein Shake''' is a bottle with brown and white pattern label.
